title: Widget Assembly Line — Overview
author: A. Engineer
content: The Widget Assembly Line is a synthetic example subsystem used to demonstrate the APS-RAG retrieval pipeline. It consists of three stations: intake, calibration, and packaging. The calibration station adjusts torque to 4.2 N·m and verifies alignment within 0.1 mm before a unit proceeds to packaging. Throughput is nominally 120 units per hour.
